panels.title: Profiles
panels.description: Users who have used the app at least once (a profile is made on their first request).

panels.title: Follows
panels.description: Follow relationships between users.

panels.title: Movies marked as watched
panels.description: Watched movies, over all profiles.

panels.title: Users with the app open
panels.description: Open live connections (server-sent events): about one per browser tab with the app open.

panels.title: Profile changes per minute, by action
panels.description: What users do: mark movies as watched, save them for later, follow people, set favourite genres. Removals that removed nothing aren't counted.

panels.title: What the profiles database holds
panels.description: Rows per table, counted every 30 s by profiles-service.

panels.title: Requests waiting for an answer
panels.description: Recommendation requests still PENDING (typed and profile).

panels.title: Answered without the model (1 h)
panels.description: Share of answers served without asking Ollama: another user's set made from identical inputs, or the same question with an unchanged profile.

panels.title: Median wait for a typed request (1 h)
panels.description: From the user's request to its answer, for Ask AI.

panels.title: Failed or timed out (1 h)
panels.description: Requests that ended in an error, or got no answer within the timeout.

panels.title: Requests per minute, by kind and outcome
panels.description: queued: a job for the worker; reused / repeated: answered without the model; already_pending / rejected: one was being made already; unavailable: a service was down.

panels.title: Time to an answer, by kind
panels.description: From the request to its answer, as the user waits for it.

panels.title: Per job: waiting vs. working (p50)
panels.description: Where a job's time goes: behind other jobs in Kafka, or in the worker (mostly Ollama).

targets.legendFormat: waiting before the worker took it

panels.title: Requests waiting, by kind
panels.description: Counted every 30 s.

panels.title: Ollama answer time (worker's view)
panels.description: How long Ollama took per recommendation set, measured by recommendation-worker (Ollama has no metrics of its own).

panels.title: Recommendation sets per minute, by outcome
Background agent: profile sets queued per hour
panels.description: Sets the background agent prepared because a profile changed (or had none).

panels.title: Searches per minute
panels.description: Searches by title and description.

panels.title: Searches finding nothing (1 h)
panels.description: Share of searches with no results, even with similar titles added.

panels.title: Movies still to embed
panels.description: Candidate movies without a vector yet: they rank below the others in Ask AI.

panels.title: Request vectors already known (1 h)
panels.description: Ask AI requests whose meaning was already embedded, so Ollama wasn't asked again.

panels.title: Search time
panels.description: Full-text search, from query to page.

panels.title: Searches per minute, by result
panels.description: Whether searches found anything, and whether similar-looking titles had to be added.

panels.title: Candidate queries: time (p95), by ranking
panels.description: The worker's candidate queries. meaning: ranked by meaning (embedded); words: by words only; taste: by the profile.

panels.title: Embedding calls to Ollama (p95), by purpose
panels.description: query: an Ask AI request; backfill: a batch of movies.

panels.title: Movies embedded per minute
panels.description: The background job's progress.

panels.title: Movies still to embed
panels.description: Counted at each background run (every minute).

targets.expr: topk(8, sum by (service, method, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_sum{namespace="movies",service=~"movies-service|profiles-service|recommendation-service",uri!~".*/events"}[5m])) / sum by (service, method, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{namespace="movies",service=~"movies-service|profiles-service|recommendation-service",uri!~".*/events"}[5m])))

panels.title: Kafka consumer lag, by group and topic
panels.description: Partitions with no committed offset yet report -1: counted as 0.

panels.title: Log lines per minute, by app
panels.description: Every line the movies namespace's containers wrote, from Loki.

panels.title: Warnings and errors per minute, by app
panels.description: Lines with WARN, ERROR or FATAL in them.

panels.title: Warnings and errors
panels.description: The lines themselves, newest first. Explore (Loki) searches every log.
